title: Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
abstract: arXiv:2611.23067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. translated_title: 价值观塑造自我改进型编程智能体所构建的内容
translated_abstract: 自我改进型智能体通常针对其产出的结果进行优化，而较少关注它们是如何产出这些结果的。它们的指令为设计者提供的塑造其工作方式的手段十分有限，尤其当任务是开放式的时候。本文研究了在智能体的持久化指令文件中加入一段简短的价值观陈述，是否不仅会改变智能体的表现好坏，还会改变它所构建的东西。本文评估了施瓦茨基本人类价值观理论中的四种高阶价值类型：对变化的开放性、保守性、自我增强和自我超越。在多样化的编程任务中，价值观在每次运行的多次自我改进迭代中保持固定。研究得出了三项发现：（1）价值观对多样化任务集的表现很重要。开放性价值观提升了在留出数据上的表现，而与之相反的保守性价值观则导致得分低于未给予任何价值观的智能体。（2）价值观会改变智能体所构建的内容……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 在自我改进型编程智能体的持久指令文件中写入简短的价值观陈述（基于施瓦茨价值观理论），不仅会显著影响其任务表现——开放性价值观能提升留出集表现，而保守性价值观的表现甚至低于无价值观的基线智能体——还会改变智能体最终构建出的成果。
en_tdlr: Embedding a short value statement based on Schwartz's theory of basic human values into a self-improving coding agent's persistent instructions changes both how well it performs and what it builds, with openness-to-change values boosting held-out performance while conservation values score below a no-values baseline.
